title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Vision-Based Robotic Grasping: A Simulated Comparison of O
summary: Revives our simulated vision-based grasping benchmark — off-policy comparisons of DQL, Monte Carlo, supervised, Corr-MC, DDPG, and PCL learners across grasping environments of varying difficulty — as the evaluation bed for the agents-rl portfolio's manipulation roadmap.
